You have added the Horse mod to an existing save. This means horses will not appear in your save*. Make sure to create a save with the mod enabled.
If you continue playing, you understand that this is not our fault, and you will not report this as a bug.
See the mod page for potential solutions to this issue.

*If you get this warning for a save created prior to v1.0.1 (February 12 to 13 2026), you can safely ignore this message.

The Horse mod adds horses to Project Zomboid, allowing the player to care for them, ride them, and much more. A stamina system makes riding feel more realistic. Craft a saddle to make your rides more comfortable, or live the life of a true nomad by adding saddlebags to your horse. If you prefer a rancher’s lifestyle, you can also craft glue from horse hooves, which works similarly to wood glue.
